home.prompt: Got space or got a bag?

howItWorksSteps.title: Need to send?
howItWorksSteps.body: Post what you want to send, where it needs to go, and when.

howItWorksSteps.title: Have extra luggage space?
howItWorksSteps.body: Post your trip and available capacity.

howItWorksSteps.title: Find a match
howItWorksSteps.body: Browse compatible send and carry requests.

howItWorksSteps.title: Connect
howItWorksSteps.body: When a match is found, message them on Telegram right away.

howItWorksSteps.title: 100% Free
howItWorksSteps.body: No fees • No commission • No hidden charges.
